tei:div.tei:p: "!# pad+ma khrag 'thung 'dus pa las: sgrub thabs snying po'i bcud dril bzhugs so:
ྈྈྈྈྈྈ pad+ma he ru ka la 'dud: pad+ma khrag 'thung 'dus pa yi: sgrub thabs snying po'i bcud dril ba: spros med don gyi rnal 'byor che: gu ru'i gsung bzhin yi ger bkod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya:
bgegs bskrad mtshams bcad skyabs sems dang: tshogs gsag mchod pa byin rlabs sogs: ji ltar rigs pa sngon song nas: dngos gzhi bskyed rim 'di ltar bsgom:

oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ: gdod ma'i stong nyid ngang las snying rje'i rtsal: hūm̐ dmar 'od kyi 'phro 'dus snod bcud sbyangs: stong gsal ngang las rdo rje'i srung 'khor dang: dur khrod rab 'jigs drag po'i gzhal yas dbus: pad nyi dregs pa rgyal bsen bsnol ba'i steng: sa bon khra thabs tshul du babs pa las: che mchog pad+ma khrag 'thung drag po rtsal: dus mtha'i me ltar rab 'bar khro zhing gtum: spyan gsum sdang mig sma ra smin ma gzengs: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags 'dril hūm̐ sgra sgrog: phyag g.yas rdo rjes snang srid zil gyis gnon: g.yon pa phur pas ma rungs snying la gzir: lcags sdig tshwa tshwas dam 'gong hab hab za: dbu gtsug rta mgo rdo rje'i dbyangs su 'tsher: 'jigs pa'i gad mos stong gsum 'gul zhing 'khyom: dur khrod chas brgyad sku yi rgyan du rngam: gar dgu'i nyams ldan zhabs gnyis dor stabs kyis: drag me dmar nag 'khrug pa'i klong na rol: spyi bor rigs bdag tshe dpag med pas mtshan: sku la zhi khro rab 'byams sprin phung 'phro: gnas gsum rdo rje'i yi ge gsal zhing 'bar: thugs ka'i 'od kyis ye shes spyan drangs

hūm̐ hrī: rak+sha srin po khros pa'i pho brang nas: stong gsum dregs pa 'dul mdzad thod phreng rtsal: pad+ma khrag 'thung drag po'i skur bzhengs nas: ma rungs log 'dren 'dul phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: hrīḥpad+ma kro dha he ru ka e h+ye hi hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ: bskyed pa'i dam tshig rten la gnyis med bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pa'i brda yis dad phyag 'tshal: drag po'i nyer spyod sman raka gtor ma'i tshogs: sbyor sgrol brtul zhugs phyag rgya'i gar gyis mchod: shrī he ru ka badz+ra ar+ghaṃ

pañtsa a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta ta na ga ṇa gu h+ya pū dza ho: hūm̐ hrī: gtum chen drag shul dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: rdo rje'i sngags sgras zhing khams kun tu g.yo: bde stong ye shes snying rje khros pa'i tshul: pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod:
de nas bzlas pa sngags kyi 'phro 'du ni:

thugs kar pha lam rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐: sngags phreng dus mtha'i me lce 'bar ba yis: dregs pa tshar bcad rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi: byin rlabs nus stobs bdag thim gnyis med gyur: oṃ ā hūm̐ pad+ma he ru ka artsig nirtsig sarba duṣ+ṭān mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa:
sgra dag ting 'dzin gsal bas 'bum phrag bzhi: bzlas pas khrag 'thung chen po'i nus stobs rdzogs: thun mthar mchod cing bstod la dngos grub gsol:
lha dang rang sems dbyer med 'od gsal ngang:
bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rgyas gdab bo:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya: rdzogs rim thugs ka'i hūm̐ dmar kho na la: rlung yid rig pa dril la mdung tshugs gtad: 'das pa 'gags shing ma 'ongs ma skyes pa'i: da lta'i shes pa rig stong lam du khyer: bdud dang dam sri rgyal 'gong la sogs pa: thams cad sems kyi snang cha kho na ste: sems la ngo bo ngos bzung mtshan ma med: stong gsal don gyi pad+ma khrag 'thung che: gzhan nas mi 'tshol rang rig 'di ka rang: 'khor 'das gnyis med chen por la bzla 'o: de ltar goms 'dris brtan pa thob pa na: gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i chos kun zil gyis gnon: rdo rje he ru ka dpal mngon sum 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya: snod ldan smin byed snying po'i gtor dbang ni: dpal gyi gtor chen brjid ldan mdzes par bsham: lha sngags ting 'dzin nus ldan cho gas bsgrub: slob mas yon phul gsol gdab rgyud sbyangs la: dam ye dbyer med brtan byas gnas gsum du: gtor ma bzhag cing sku gsung thugs dbang sbyin: hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub pad+ma khrag 'thung sku: rtsa gsum rab 'byams sku dang gnyis su med: skal ldan bu yi lus la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim sku yi dbang mchog thob par shog: sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub pad+ma khrag 'thung gsung: rtsa gsum rab 'byams gsung dang gnyis su med: skal ldan bu yi ngag la dbang bskur bas: nus pa sngags kyi dbang mchog thob par shog:

wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub pad+ma khrag 'thung thugs: rtsa gsum rab 'byams thugs dang gnyis su med: skal ldan bu yi yid la dbang bskur bas: rig rtsal don gyi dbang mchog thob par shog: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: slar yang gtor ma spyi bor bzhag byas la: hūm̐ hrī: 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pad+ma khrag 'thung rtsal: rgyal ba sras bcas rnams dang gnyis su med: rtsa gsum lha tshogs sku yi dbyings su rdzogs: skal ldan slob ma'i spyi bor mngon sum byon: sgo gsum nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad sol: smin grol dbang dang byin rlabs char ltar phob: rang byung rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: sarba sid+dhi hrī: zhes brjod gtor ma'i lha bstim dngos grub sbyin: bkra shis brjod cing me tog char chen dbab: bar chad bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rab rgyal nas: pad+ma khrag 'thung nus stobs rdzogs par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya: bde gshegs kun 'dus pad+ma khrag 'thung gi: smin grol spros med don gyi gdams zab 'di: ma 'ongs don phyir rin chen gter du sbas: las 'phro can gyi bu dang 'phrad par shog:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug rtsa gsum gter bdag gling pa'i zab gter gyi snying po'o// ༈ //'di'i brgyud pa/ chos longs sprul gsum/ mtsho rgyal/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rwa ston/ thugs mchog rdo rje/ dri med gling pa/ ye shes lhun grub/ rdo rje snying po/ o rgyan 'gro 'dul/ pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa/ des so/// /
